schemas.attempt_conversion: attempts_on_dropbacks / provider_dropbacks; total credited ATT retained separately
schemas.QB_share: Own historical attributed counts / same past-game team count; not future workload or role probability
schemas.context: Raw marginal down/distance/field counts; thin cells require consuming learner regularization, not exact predictive assertions

readiness.current_adapter: CURRENT_QUERY_ADAPTER_IMPLEMENTED; current profile unavailable without qualified pregame membership

unchanged_coverage_note: The source profiles do not test five weeks, fit models, produce future selections or make a deployment claim.
